test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 2 8 + 7 5 > 9 2 @ 3 = 4 6 % 3 & 8 4 % 9 1 8 3 # 7 6 9 (Right)

How many such symbols are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 2 8 + 7 5 > 9 2 @ 3 = 4 6 % 3 & 8 4 % 9 1 8 3 # 7 6 9 (Right)

According to the question:

Required condition: Odd number - Symbols - Odd number

(Left) 2 8 + 7 __**5 > 9**__ 2 @ 3 = 4 6 % 3 & 8 4 % 9 1 8 __**3 # 7**__ 6 9 (Right)

Thus, there are two such symbols which are immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
